# `aube access revoke`

- **Usage:** `aube access revoke <TEAM> <PACKAGE>`
- **Effect:** destructive — may delete or irreversibly overwrite

Revoke a team's access to a package.

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

Read the [workflow guide](/package-manager/publishing) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->

## Arguments

- **`<TEAM>`** — Team in `@scope:team` form.
- **`<PACKAGE>`** — Package name.

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help
